question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Occurrance"** is incorrectly spelt. • The correct spelling is "**Occurrence**." • **​"Occurrence" ** refers to something that happens or takes place. (घटना) • **Example: **The **occurrence **of frequent power cuts has become a major issue in the town. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Conscious** (सचेत): Being aware of and responding to one's surroundings. • **Example:** She became **conscious **of someone following her. • **Receive** (प्राप्त करना): To be given, presented with, or paid (something). • **Example:** I **received **a gift on my birthday. • **Believe** (विश्वास करना): To accept that something is true, especially without proof. • **Example:** I **believe **in working hard to achieve success. 1a0:T1b6e,
